notes.title: Hotfix for Achievements Is Out Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

An unpleasant bug managed to fly under our radars when the most recent patch was released and because of it, some of you were unable to unlock achievements in the game.

We have now released a hotfix that fixes this issue, meaning you should again be able to unlock every achievement that the game has to offer. We apologize for the inconvenience. 

Thank you very much for your feedback and bug reports! If there's anything else you wish to share with us, the Steam forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/CVvD8JP9zG]Discord[/url] server are perfect places to do so!

notes.title: Patch 3.5.24 Has Just Been Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Yes, there is a new patch for Diluvian Ultra! Thanks to the support and feedback you keep sharing here on Steam and on our [url=https://discord.gg/CVvD8JP9zG]Discord[/url] server, we've been able to track down and fix some of the issues that were bothering you, our beloved fans.

Full Change Log can be found below.

Thank you very much for staying with us - while we work on further fixes and even new content for Diluvian Ultra, we cordially invite you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/CVvD8JP9zG]Discord[/url] server; not only to report more bugs if you find any or share your suggestions, but even just to hang out with the community and the dev team!


[b]Change Log:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed weapons sometimes being removed when playing normally past C01L02
[*] fixed weapons being removed when restarting a level after starting to play through an already completed level
[*] fixed levels sometimes becoming locked, preventing further progression
[*] fixed level materials in C01L08 - C01L07 - C01L05
[*] removed an extra yellow key in C01L01
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update on the Present and Future of Diluvian Ultra
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

[b]New players, old players and those yet to take the plunge into the world of Diluvian Ultra alike, hear me![/b]

Me and the team ([i]3 of us in total[/i]) just want to say that for about three weeks now we have watched you play, listened to feedback and noted down issues and pesky bugs. 

It has been great fun, exciting and terrifying, watching you all take our game for a spin, and very enlightening. [b]But this is just the beginning.[/b] In the coming weeks you will see updates, with us [b]improving features[/b], [b]squashing bugs[/b] and evolving Diluvian Ultra into the best FPS we can dream up. After all, that is why me, Stagnation and Quandini got into this to begin with. 

If you'd like to be a part of this journey and help shape the evolution of Diluvian Ultra, we are very approachable and the easiest way is to join our [url=https://discord.gg/jyg9vPTV9S]DISCORD[/url].

[b]And if you would leave a quick review here on Steam, it would help us a lot![/b]

[b]I can also say that soon we are going to start showing off sneak peeks of [i][b]Chapter 2 - The Path of the Traitor[/b][/i]. More story, more guns, more enemies and more levels.[/b] Actually, let's give you a first little glimpse right now, shall we?

[i]Have you wondered how the other Diluvians except Atilla, our main character, spend their time? Well, the time will soon come to journey through the Valley of the Kings where the palaces of the Diluvian Princes dot the landscape.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633084/c1482f439b77f255581e2c8c519e008aab894cd5.png[/img]

There are scores to settle for Atilla and his Squire Bella. I hope you will want to tag along.

If you have not already, jump on in and get introduced to Atilla and his world. Smashing robots and firing off bug weapons is always a good time, wouldn't you agree? 

For those of you that are already familiar with Diluvian Ultra, feel free to come talk to us. We don't bite. 

Me (StraitCurrent), Stagnation and Quandini want to thank you all and hope you will follow along as Diluvian Ultra grows and evolves.

[b]Thank you![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306970/Diluvian_Ultra/

notes.title: First Patch for Chapter One Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here we are with the first patch for Diluvian Ultra Chapter One - It is filled with fixes and changes you have been asking for. The full list of changes and fixes is below, but most notable are changes to the audio of enemy barks, fixing many controller issues and improvements to the flow of texts.

We are aware that not all reported issues have been fixed, but we decided that publishing an incremental improvement is better than having you wait until everything is done.

There are two issues specifically that we are working on fixing as soon as possible, but can already be somewhat remedied if you encounter them:
[list]
[*] There is a bug that can sometimes corrupt a Waystone save and cause you to lose all weapons when you die and respawn. Going to the menu and selecting "restart level" should restore your arsenal, albeit losing the progress you've made in that particular level of course. The bug is difficult to replicate however, and while this worked for us, [b]we cannot guarantee it will work every time[/b] - please let us know here in the comments, in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1306970/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/nPdPBtQvMN]Discord server[/url] if you encounter this issue and whether restarting the level solved it for you or not. The more details we have, the easier it will be for us to squash the bug!
[*] If you start a game and cannot move and in general it seems unresponsive to any keyboard commands, make sure you don't have a controller plugged in or wirelessly connected - currently it disables the keyboard and "takes over".
[/list]


If there is something else you want us to focus on, please, leave your feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1306970/discussions/]here on Steam[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/nPdPBtQvMN]Discord[/url] server where you can chat with us directly!

And if you're enjoying Diluvian Ultra Chapter One, we would be incredibly happy if you wrote a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1306970/reviews/]review[/url] of it here on Steam, it really does help a lot!


[h3][b]Full Change Log:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed Waystone and powerup messages sometimes staying on screen
[*] Fixed first line of dialogue disappearing too fast
[*] Fixed various controller support issues
[*] Fixed rebinding keys in the main menu not working
[*] Fixed weapon FOV acting strange
[*] Fixes the potential soft lock with events triggered from dialogue
[*] Fixed crash from dying whilst locked in place during dialogue
[*] Fixed AI falling comically slowly
[*] Fixed step-up issues in various maps
[*] Fixed C01L02 collision improvements
[*] Improved forks, now have a muted display when activated
[*] Fixed visual issues with Ion Impaler and heal animation
[*] Improved readability of some map encounters in C01L01
[*] Increased size of chaingun projectile to better read damage type
[*] Changed chaingun muzzle flash to better reflect damage type
[*] Increased amount of blood and ammo in C01L09
[*] Added powerup effects, now have a ring effect to make them stand out more
[*] Improved destructible lattice gibs, now coloured correctly
[*] Updated material for trees
[*] Fixed issues with squiregun guide tutorial text reappearing when you access the waystone again
[*] Lowered the chance of barks and increased the cooldown on them triggering
[*] Lowered the ping audio for enemy barks.
[/list]

notes.title: Diluvian Ultra design update: Octodrone
notes.content:
[h1]Enemy presentation: The Octodrone[/h1]

Hello! I wanted to talk a bit about the enemies you will encounter in Diluvian Ultra.

If you tried out our demo, or any of the builds we put out over the years. You are familiar with our basic roster, with Marines, Drones and Elites. 

These are the three basic enemy types that you will encounter frequently. Other enemies are often varieties of one of these three, like the Shotgun Marine, or the Light Drone. But, we are also working on bigger and more fearsome foes as well.  

Like the Octodrone:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633084/c9558ff2ac4a906b94f6172df09b010713132334.gif[/img]

The Octodrone is a moving factory. A big, mean, robot that constructs gun turrets called Gorgons and deploy them to create walls of firepower. The Octodrone is tough and has the ability to repair other robot enemies and even itself when damaged. Although, it prefers to run away from the player should they approach. Away from the melee, the Octodrone can set up its web of turrets in peace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633084/93e9c0bbdee4b72a3bc5c8e0063820be4e2396f2.gif[/img]

Leave the Octodrone to its own devices too long and soon you will be fighting a seemingly immortal army of robot enemies, while Gorgons pepper you with fire from every angle.
 
Right now we are testing out the design, as QUANDINI, our programmer, has created an all new state machine for the AI to use for their behaviour. We hope to soon transition all old AI behaviour to this state machine, so we can more easily fine tune the behaviour of all enemies.

More updates to come! 

StraitCurrent, 
designer

notes.title: Diluvian Ultra Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

The Diluvian Ultra team is working hard on meeting our release date for the early access release next year. We aim to have a full single player campaign of 9 levels for everyone to enjoy.

After the release of our demo last year we got a lot of good feedback and we decided to take the opportunity to improve on the core of the game. We sat about reworking some systems to improve on performance and make the game feel more responsive with improved movement and a better AI system.

We have also collaborated with freelance artist to create a soundtrack for Diluvian and create some awesome cover art for the game.
